name: Describing Places
blurb: Cảnh quan, không khí, kiến trúc

words.definitionEn: a large area of countryside, especially in relation to its appearance
words.example: The landscape of the Scottish Highlands is breathtakingly beautiful.

words.definitionEn: visually attractive, especially in a quaint or charming way
words.example: The picturesque village of Hallstatt attracts millions of tourists each year.

words.definitionEn: full of people moving about in a busy way
words.example: The bustling streets of Tokyo never seem to sleep.

words.definitionEn: calm, peaceful, and untroubled
words.example: The serene atmosphere of the lake made it a perfect spot for meditation.

words.definitionEn: spreading out over a large area in an untidy or irregular way
words.example: The sprawling metropolis of Los Angeles extends for miles along the coast.

words.definitionEn: in a state of disrepair or ruin as a result of age or neglect
words.example: The dilapidated factory was demolished to make way for a new park.

words.definitionEn: relating to the design and construction of buildings
words.example: The city is famous for its architectural heritage, including Gothic cathedrals and modern skyscrapers.

words.definitionEn: the basic physical and organizational structures needed for a society to operate
words.example: The government invested heavily in improving the infrastructure of rural areas.

words.definitionEn: relating to a large city or a city and its surrounding areas
words.example: Metropolitan areas often offer a wider range of cultural activities than smaller towns.

words.definitionEn: relating to the countryside rather than the town
words.example: Many people move to rural areas to escape the noise of the city.

words.definitionEn: relating to a city or town
words.example: Urban planning plays a crucial role in creating sustainable cities.

words.definitionEn: providing beautiful views of the countryside or natural features
words.example: The scenic route along the coast offers stunning views of the ocean.

words.definitionEn: pleasant, attractive, and delightful
words.example: The charming old town with its cobblestone streets is a popular tourist destination.

words.definitionEn: famous or important in history
words.example: The historic castle has been preserved for centuries.

words.definitionEn: full of energy, activity, and life
words.example: The vibrant nightlife of the city attracts many young people.

words.definitionEn: free from disturbance or noise; calm
words.example: The tranquil garden was a perfect place to relax after a busy day.

words.definitionEn: attracting and holding one's attention; fascinating
words.example: The captivating view of the sunset over the mountains left everyone speechless.

words.definitionEn: the remains of a building or structure that has been destroyed or has fallen into disrepair
words.example: The ancient ruins of the temple are a UNESCO World Heritage site.

words.definitionEn: the outline of buildings, mountains, etc., against the sky
words.example: The skyline of Hong Kong is dominated by towering skyscrapers.

words.definitionEn: the character, feeling, or mood of a place
words.example: The atmosphere in the old café was warm and inviting.

words.definitionEn: attractively unusual or old-fashioned
words.example: The quaint cottages with thatched roofs are a common sight in the English countryside.

words.definitionEn: impressive in size, appearance, or manner
words.example: The imposing cathedral dominates the city's skyline.

words.meaningVi: ngoạn mục, đẹp đến nghẹt thở
words.definitionEn: astonishing or awe-inspiring in quality, so as to take one's breath away
words.example: The breathtaking views from the mountain peak made the climb worthwhile.

words.meaningVi: hoang sơ, chưa bị tác động
words.definitionEn: not harmed or damaged; still in its original natural state
words.example: The unspoiled beaches of the island are a paradise for nature lovers.

words.definitionEn: familiar with and comfortable in many different countries and cultures
words.example: London is a cosmopolitan city with a diverse population and global influences.

words.definitionEn: belonging to the very distant past
words.example: The ancient ruins of the temple attract thousands of tourists every year.

words.definitionEn: extremely interesting or attractive
words.example: The city's fascinating blend of modern and traditional architecture is a sight to behold.

words.definitionEn: filled with many people or things
words.example: The crowded streets of the old town made it difficult to walk freely.

words.definitionEn: free from disturbance; calm
words.example: The peaceful countryside offers a perfect escape from the hustle and bustle of city life.

words.definitionEn: full of life and energy
words.example: The lively market square is always filled with locals and tourists alike.

words.definitionEn: attractive or interesting
words.example: The appealing coastal scenery makes this region a popular holiday destination.

words.definitionEn: giving a sense of happy satisfaction or enjoyment
words.example: The pleasant climate of the island contributes to its year-round tourism.

words.meaningVi: toàn cảnh, quang cảnh bao quát
words.definitionEn: an unbroken view of a wide area
words.example: From the top of the hill, visitors can enjoy a stunning panorama of the entire valley.

words.definitionEn: so crowded with traffic or people that it is difficult to move
words.example: The city's congested roads during rush hour are a major source of frustration for commuters.

words.definitionEn: not seen or visited by many people; private and quiet
words.example: The secluded beach is ideal for those seeking peace and solitude.

words.definitionEn: of vegetation growing thickly and luxuriantly
words.example: The lush green hills of the countryside are a delight to hikers and nature lovers.

words.definitionEn: full of life and activity
words.example: The animated streets of the festival quarter are filled with music and laughter.

words.definitionEn: covering a large area; extensive
words.example: The expansive plains stretch as far as the eye can see, offering a sense of freedom.

words.definitionEn: in its original condition; unspoiled
words.example: The pristine waters of the lake remain crystal clear due to strict environmental protection.

words.meaningVi: cầu kỳ, trang trí phức tạp
words.definitionEn: decorated with a lot of complex details
words.example: The ornate ceiling of the cathedral features intricate carvings and gold leaf.

words.definitionEn: having little or no rain; very dry
words.example: The arid desert landscape is both harsh and beautiful in its starkness.

words.definitionEn: crowded with people or things
words.example: The main square is always thronged with tourists during the summer season.

words.definitionEn: in a state of severe disrepair; tumbledown
words.example: The ramshackle buildings along the waterfront have been abandoned for decades.

words.definitionEn: having grandeur or beauty that inspires admiration
words.example: The majestic mountain peaks are covered in snow throughout the year.

words.definitionEn: traces or remains of something that no longer exists
words.example: The vestiges of the ancient Roman forum can still be seen in the city centre.

words.meaningVi: hùng vĩ, cao cả, tuyệt vời
words.definitionEn: of outstanding beauty or grandeur
words.example: The sublime beauty of the sunset over the ocean left the visitors speechless.

words.definitionEn: rich and luxurious
words.example: The opulent palaces of the former royal family are now open to the public.

words.definitionEn: extremely pleasant, peaceful, and picturesque
words.example: The idyllic village with its thatched cottages and flower-filled gardens is a photographer's dream.

words.meaningVi: phức tạp như mê cung, rối rắm
words.definitionEn: like a labyrinth; complicated and confusing
words.example: The labyrinthine layout of the old market makes it easy to get lost.

words.meaningVi: xanh tươi, phủ đầy cây cỏ
words.definitionEn: green with grass or other rich vegetation
words.example: The verdant landscapes of the national park are a haven for wildlife.
